context.content: According to the page you linked it'll be [this design](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2f/Deutscher_Personalausweis_%282021_Version%29.jpg) from August 2. It doesn't look too different from the old one. As the new ID card requires the storage of fingerprints (which I think is crappy), I actually decided to renew my ID card 2 weeks ago, so I'll still get to use an "old" one until 2031.
